services.name: Summer Camp
services.desc: at the Canadian Warplane Heritage Museum offers an exciting, immersive adventure into the world of aviation. All programs are led by experienced adult members of the museum’s education team. The camp takes place within the museum facility and at the surrounding airport grounds, providing a unique and engaging environment. Campers enjoy a full daytime schedule featuring aviation themed hands-on activities and games, drone flying, model building, and flight simulator experiences. A highlight of the week is a memorable flight aboard our historic World War II veteran Douglas C-47 Dakota transport aircraft. "An incredible experience with amazing staff who kept the kids engaged
